description:
About the company
 Our client is a fast-growing artificial intelligence company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Serve as the mobile client specialist for a cross-platform application, owning stability, performance and a native feel across a wide range of devices. The work combines hands-on client development with diagnosing problems from crash data and user reports.
 What you'll do
 - Serve as the mobile client subject-matter expert on a small engineering team.
 - Review crash data, bug reports and cross-platform comparisons to decide where engineering effort should go.
 - Keep the application stable and native-feeling across many device models and manufacturer variations.
 - Build and maintain mobile client features in Kotlin and Java.
 - Work on low-level device integration, including native components.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Experience building complex mobile client apps that cope with differences in audio hardware, screen sizes and manufacturer-specific behavior.
 - Background working on software that reaches a broad audience at scale.
 - Hands-on experience building and shipping production native mobile apps.
 - A long-term focus on mobile client work rather than using the role as a stepping stone to other work.
 Bonus points
 - Experience with voice products, on-device machine learning or iOS development.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 220,000 to 350,000 per year
 - Equity
 - Health, dental and vision coverage
 - Parental leave
 - Flexible time off
 - 401k retirement plan
 - Commuter benefits
 - Relocation assistance
 Location and work model
 - San Francisco, California, United States
 - Hybrid, with in-person days in the office preferred; remote within US time zones is open for strong senior candidates, with monthly in-person visits to the office
 - Full-time
